note: Set B binds the source values correctly and consistently — 3/4" x 5 1/2" plywood deck and reclaimed wood surface, 2" x 8" frame and joist, 3/4" threaded rod, 1" nut, 4x4 post 'to be cut as needed', FIRST FLR 2'-4" above GRADE LEVEL 0". Set A invents several quotes and values not on the page (5/4" x 6" x 12" pressure treated surfacing, 3/4" x 4' x 8' plywood, 1'-6", 2" SLEEVE) and misstates real ones (2" x 6" joist instead of 2" x 8", 1/2" threaded rod instead of 3/4"). Set B's weaknesses are duplicates and a few vague or misbound dimensions (joist given as 3/4" x 5 1/2", 8'-0" attributed to the footing plan, 4x4 called a footing member), but it has far fewer substantive errors. Set A also misassigns A6/B4 dimensions to the wrong details (1 1/4", 3 3/4", 7 1/2", 8'-0" as Footing Elevation width).
